_comment: Registry of the kernel's automated tasks. Single source of truth for chat-agent delegation + cron reference. This installation's own tasks (and any field it overrides on a kernel task) live in agent/local/tasks.json, same shape; every reader sees the two merged by lib/registry.cjs (`node lib/registry.cjs tasks`). Edit, then run 'jori doctor' to verify cron + playbook alignment.

tasks.name: morning-digest
tasks.description: Compile calendar, tasks, news headlines, and weather; send to Jori.

tasks.name: context-sync
tasks.description: Re-index Apple Notes, iMessage, email memories, and project files into the context search database.

tasks.name: skill-repair
tasks.schedule_human: On demand the moment a repair is queued; hourly at :47 as a safety net
tasks.description: Same-day repair of a read-only browser action or page parser that stopped reading its site (queued by an installation's ingest job on a source's first bad run and by skill-health on the first failure day; lib/skill-repair.mjs). Reads the live page, rewrites the one action with the same output shape, verifies rows return, lands via self-improve-auto-apply. Silent. Queue: bin/skill-repair list. See ops-agent/jobs/skill-repair.md.

tasks.name: hum
tasks.schedule_human: Every 20 minutes — the always-on hum of ambient awareness
tasks.description: Every 20 minutes, evaluates the user's current situation (location, calendar, messages, git commits, audio context, weather) and decides whether to surface useful information, ask a context-building question, or stay silent. Most ticks exit silently via bash gates. Questions with answers grow memory files under ~/.claude/projects/.../memory/ for better future context. Replaces the old lane-rotation pulse.

tasks.name: hum-review
tasks.description: Weekly self-assessment of hum: analyzes 7 days of ticks, pings, questions, answers, reactions, and memory growth. Emails the user a memo with engagement stats and proposed tuning. Never applies tuning automatically — proposals only. Read-only on all hum state files.

tasks.name: hum-consolidate
tasks.description: Nightly fold of the day's replies-to-hum-pings (hum-responses.jsonl) into the general wiki, so hum stops re-asking things the user already answered. Durable preferences/facts become linked, deduped wiki pages via wiki save; transient resolutions are skipped. Trigger gates on un-consolidated rows; silent (no email/ping/push). Replaced hum-answer's old realtime subsection routing (2026-06-28).

tasks.name: hum-daily
tasks.description: Chronicle of the last 24h of hum ticks — what harvesters discovered, what pings/questions were sent and why. Email (personal, starred) + short phone pointer. Direct script, no agent turn (bin/hum-daily-run, 2026-10-04).

tasks.name: hum-ideation
tasks.schedule_human: 4× daily at 6:00 AM, 11:00 AM, 2:00 PM, 7:00 PM local
tasks.description: Twice-daily proactive idea generation for hum. Reads calendar, tasks, gmail, trip-history, recent reactions. Builds a reinforcement-biased mix (exploit top categories, explore untested, retry failed with variation). Writes 8-15 new ideas to hum-ideas.jsonl + rebuilds the reaction scorecard. Never pings, never emails — ideas surface through the normal hum tick via the `ideas` harvester.

tasks.name: nightly-review
tasks.schedule_human: Weekly Tuesday at 5:00 AM — after the 4:00 AM daily summary it reads, moved from 3:00 AM on 2026-10-22 (launchd agent ai.claude.improvement-review, NOT cron — cron can't reach the in-session Max keychain; also runs on ephemeral Opus 5, not the webhook-dispatched ops supervisor, since 2026-07-28)
tasks.description: Weekly holistic system self-assessment and improvement memo, covering the prior 7 days. Job/script names retain the historical 'nightly-review' label. Chains improvement-plan on a clean exit.

tasks.name: improvement-plan
tasks.schedule_human: Chained by nightly-review on a clean exit; launchd agent ai.claude.improvement-plan (Tue 10:30 AM, past the review's 05:00 start plus both runs' caps) is a safety-net slot only, guarded against re-running on a stale report
tasks.description: Acts on every ACTION ITEM of the weekly Self Improvement Review: safe changes land on their own through self-improve-auto-apply (green check in Improvements), complex or high-blast-radius ones become Face-ID cards (rubric schema v4, 2026-09-29), questions go to the next review. Runs on ephemeral Opus 5 via run-ephemeral-opus.sh. Cards capped at 5 unsigned total.

tasks.name: wiki-audit
tasks.description: Nightly re-evaluation of the wiki pinned-page subset. Reads `data/wiki-access.jsonl` (last 7 days, MCP caller only), pins any unpinned page hit ≥ 5 times, unpins any pinned page with 0 hits AND pinned for ≥ 7 days AND not pin_locked. Logs the moves to the Improvements channel (green-check row) only when something changes (silent on no-op nights); no email since 2026-10-07. Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API.

tasks.name: memory-snapshot
tasks.description: Auto-commit + push the auto-memory dir to its private backup repo. Idempotent on no-changes. Primary backup layer — protects against rm/corruption/bad-merge of the 80+ .md files at ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/memory/. Pre-reindex tarballs in data/memory-snapshots/ are belt-and-suspenders.

tasks.name: wiki-db-snapshot
tasks.description: Hourly hot snapshot of data/memory-index.db via SQLite VACUUM INTO. Rotates to the last 24 copies under data/memory-db-snapshots/. Defense-in-depth backup for the wiki layer (`pages` / `page_links` / `page_revisions` / `pages_fts` and the legacy `memory_chunks` index) — protects against DB corruption (e.g. the 2026-05-02 FTS5 incident). Restore = `cp memory-db-snapshots/memory-index-<ts>.db data/memory-index.db`. Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API.

tasks.name: wiki-cloud-sync
tasks.description: Off-box copy of the wiki. Reconciles Supabase wiki_pages / wiki_page_links / wiki_page_revisions (jori project) to data/memory-index.db via `bin/wiki-cloud-sync push` — stateless row-hash diff for pages+links, rowid cursor for revisions (data/wiki-cloud-sync.json). Pages 3 failures in a row via jori-notify --channel system. Restore = `wiki-cloud-sync restore --db <new-file>` then swap in + re-run wiki-embed. Check = `wiki-cloud-sync verify`. Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API.

tasks.name: chrome-cdp-watch
tasks.description: Probe Chrome DevTools Protocol on port 9222 and notify the user once per UP→DOWN transition so they can investigate a lost TCC grant / closed Chrome / chrome-devtools-mcp re-sign. Silent on recovery. Quiet hours 00:00–09:00 local defer the ping to the 09:00-tick. State in data/chrome-cdp-state.json. Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API.

tasks.name: hum-explore
tasks.schedule_human: Daily at 12:30 PM and 5:30 PM local (clock-jobs.json); sends at most 2 a week
tasks.description: Hum exploration (replaced the weekly canary 2026-10-07): at most twice a week, 48h apart, sends the best fresh held-back discretionary item in a lane where hum is still guessing, as an ordinary 'Borderline pick:' ping through hum-ping (budget/dedup refusals apply), with one line on what it is and why it was sent, and the item's link. The user's reaction calibrates the lane via hum-engagement. Direct script, no agent turn: since 2026-10-15 the cron trigger kicks launchd agent ai.claude.hum-explore, whose run-hum-explore.sh checks the Max login (so the resolve-first gate and precheck can run) and then runs bin/hum-explore-run; no verified login means the pick is held.

tasks.name: usage-push
tasks.description: Push per-day model-weighted Claude usage/cost rollups (from jori-cost-report --push, unioning the ops/-light/-haiku ledgers) to the hosted /usage telemetry endpoint for central, durable monitoring across hosts. Sends the real metered weighted cost, not the SDK phantom estimate. Runs after midnight over a 2-day window; idempotent per (host, day). Requires JORI_USAGE_TOKEN (or STATS_TOKEN) in .env. Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API. Non-fatal when there are no cost rows. NOTE: confirm the cron slot via jori-cron-slots on the host.

tasks.name: recall-events-embed
tasks.description: Backfill local Ollama (nomic-embed-text) embeddings for high-value events in the events_fts recall index, powering recall_events mode:hybrid. Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API. Degrades gracefully (recall stays FTS-only if Ollama is down). Added 2026-07-08 with the semantic-recall feature.

tasks.name: wiki-embed
tasks.description: Backfill local Ollama (nomic-embed-text) embeddings for new/changed wiki pages (pages -> page_embeddings in memory-index.db), powering wiki_search mode:hybrid. Re-embeds a page when its body_hash changes; prunes embeddings for deleted pages. Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API. Degrades gracefully (wiki_search stays FTS-only if Ollama is down). Added 2026-07-19 to extend hybrid recall from the event log to the curated wiki.

tasks.name: wiki-assoc
tasks.schedule_human: Daily 4:20 AM local (after wiki-embed); the model half runs in the launchd agent ai.claude.wiki-assoc-llm it kicks
tasks.description: Nightly writers for associative memory (system/wiki-architecture.md § Associative recall). Under cron, no model: `wiki-assoc nightly` folds new auto-recall judge rows into page_coactivation (pages kept together for the same message, decayed Hebbian weights), writes data/wiki-link-candidates.json (strong co-used pairs with no link, read by wiki-link-weave Step 5.5), and rebuilds page_activation (ACT-R base-level activation from judge-kept recalls and deliberate wiki_read/episode_get reads, never search hits). Then it kicks the on-demand launchd agent ai.claude.wiki-assoc-llm (run-wiki-assoc-llm.sh, behind max-auth-guard): typed fact extraction into page_facts and trigger cues into page_cues, each through the local → Sonnet ladder with a verbatim-evidence check and a per-run Sonnet cap. Silent; log agent/logs/wiki-assoc.log. Added 2026-10-24.

tasks.name: system-issue-review
tasks.schedule_human: Daily at 4:27 AM local (launchd agent ai.claude.system-issue-review, NOT cron — cron can't reach the in-session Max keychain; also runs on ephemeral Opus 5, not the webhook-dispatched ops supervisor, since 2026-07-28)
phrases: why does that alert keep firing
tasks.description: Nightly root-cause pass over Jori's own system channel. Clusters the last 14 days of alerts into distinct issues (by condition, not wording), correlates recovery messages, closes out verified fixes, then works two lanes: up to 3 fix attempts and up to 3 cheaper review-only passes. Every issue is reviewed even if it healed itself (2026-07-25) -- a recovery closes the incident, never the issue, and nothing reaches a terminal status without a recorded root cause. Low/moderate fixes are implemented + critic-reviewed + committed autonomously and shown as a green-check card in the Improvements channel; high-risk fixes are staged as one Face-ID card per night. A review concluding no code change is warranted is recorded silently (status reviewed / resolution reviewed-no-fix) and surfaces in the weekly nightly-review roundup.

tasks.name: system-issue-review-critical
tasks.schedule_human: Hourly at :52 (--critical-only; dispatches only on a NEW critical alert). launchd agent ai.claude.system-issue-review-critical, NOT cron — cron can't reach the in-session Max keychain; also runs on ephemeral Opus 5, not the webhook-dispatched ops supervisor, since 2026-07-28
tasks.description: Same-day escalation lane for system-issue-review, added 2026-07-25 so a capability-down issue does not wait up to 24h for the nightly pass. Runs hourly but dispatches ONLY when a genuinely new critical-marker alert landed in the system channel; warnings, recoveries, and repeats of an issue already in flight all wait for the nightly run. Deduplication lives in lib/system-issue-gate.mjs and is the whole point: in a real 14-day window most critical alerts were repeats of one or two conditions, so a naive gate would have fired over a dozen heavy dispatches in one night for one already-carded issue (heavy tier = the ops supervisor, which runs claude-sonnet-5; an escalation turn is one of the most expensive turns it runs). When it does dispatch, the job scopes to a single cluster on a ~15-minute budget.

tasks.name: cost-efficiency-review
tasks.schedule_human: Daily at 2:37 AM local (launchd agent ai.claude.cost-efficiency-review, NOT cron — cron can't reach the in-session Max keychain; runs on ephemeral Opus 5 like the rest of the improvement family). Slot reserved via jori-cron-slots.
phrases: why is jori using so much budget
how much did jori cost today
tasks.description: Daily review of WHERE the Max budget actually went in the last 24h — not which job spent the most, but whether the spend bought WORK or bought CONTEXT. Reads a pre-fetched `jori-cost-report --efficiency --json` (the trigger fetches it un-sandboxed) and compares against the 2026-08-06 baseline: cost split by token type, the measured context FLOOR per supervisor, the working window above it, and the compact/rotate churn that follows when that window closes. Flags a regression when overhead rises >5 points, a floor grows >5k, a working window drops under 40k, or 24h spend exceeds 1.4x the 7d median — then attributes it to a specific change (a new always-loaded CLAUDE.md section, an added MCP server, a gate that stopped gating, a job that got heavier) and files cuts through the unified self-improvement pipeline: low/moderate auto-apply with a green-check card, high risk (model tier, output quality, capability removal) as a Face-ID card it can never self-approve. Silent when nothing regressed. Exists because a single day can burn a large share of the weekly cap, most of it cache traffic, and nightly-review's weekly job-shaped cost lens could not see it.

tasks.name: inbox-mem-sync
tasks.description: Pull recent mail into the inbox memory channel (FTS + embeddings in memory-index.db) so `recall` — and the release freshness gate that asks it — can see what the mailbox already knows. Silent; no user output.

tasks.name: inbox-mem-sync-deep
tasks.description: Nightly wide-window inbox re-index + prune. Repairs whatever the 20-minute short window missed (outage, burst past --max) and bounds index growth at 120 days.

tasks.name: watch-review
tasks.description: Weekly scorecard + coverage audit of the watch engine: every reminder request in the week's chat became a watch? did watches fire on time, reach the user, help? Ships <=3 fixes, keeps data/watch-review/history.jsonl, emails only when something happened.

tasks.name: sleep-night
tasks.description: Combine the phone's last lock before the night / first unlock after it (phone_lock_events, live) with the Apple Watch's sleep onset/wake (health_samples, lands late) into sleep_nights; refresh data/sleep-night-state.json so `jori activity` follows the phone. Deterministic, no agent dispatch.

tasks.name: plaid-sync
tasks.schedule_human: 12:15 AM and 10:15 AM local (backstop; the primary trigger is Plaid's SYNC_UPDATES_AVAILABLE webhook)
tasks.description: Pull Plaid balances + transactions into plaid_accounts/plaid_transactions and push alerts (a large charge unusual for its merchant, a large deposit, low balance, re-auth needed). Direct script — no agent, no Anthropic API. READ-ONLY, cannot move money. A backstop: the webhook (agent/supervisor/plaid-webhook.mjs) drives the sync per Item when the bank posts. Thresholds, webhook URL: agent/local/config/finance.json. Kill switches: data/.plaid-sync-off (both paths), data/.plaid-webhook-off (event path only). No connected Items → a no-op.

tasks.name: finance-model
tasks.description: Nightly build of the finance model (subscriptions, regular income streams, merchant stats, category baselines, recurring obligations) → data/finance-model.json, read by the finance hum harvester. Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API. READ-ONLY over plaid_*. Installation follow-up work rides the optional _ext/finance-model-after.sh hook. Kill switch: data/.finance-model-off.

tasks.name: flights-scan
tasks.description: Scan Gmail for flight/accommodation/car-rental confirmations (sender-domain lists + optional trip-organiser forward address in agent/local/config/flights-scan.json) and refresh data/flights.json; owns the matching calendar events and runs `travel sync`. The daily cron is the safety net; travel change/cancellation emails also dispatch it via the ops-agent triage travel-change fast-path. Scripted: the trigger kicks launchd agent ai.claude.flights-scan, which runs bin/flights-scan-run (one tool-less model call to read emails). No agent turn.

tasks.name: purchase
tasks.description: Dispatches one queued purchase to the ops agent (jobs/purchase.md); started by bin/purchase-queue, never by cron. Face ID in the app approves; code places the order.

tasks.name: purchase-signin
tasks.description: Keep the shop Chrome signed in to the installation's top merchants (data/purchase-merchants.json; jobs/purchase-signin.md). Weekly, daytime, since 2FA codes go to the phone.

tasks.name: trip-reservoir-autoscan
tasks.schedule_human: Daily at 2:00 AM local via launchd user agent ai.claude.trip-reservoir-autoscan (NOT cron — the Sonnet research fork needs the keychain Max session; overnight, research is web-search-heavy)
tasks.description: Nightly gate: finds any upcoming NON-HOME location on the travel timeline that has no travel guide (reservoir) yet, and researches each one sequentially with trip-reservoir-build (geocodes any city worldwide) directly from the launchd agent. Skips the home metros (travel.json home_metros) and short layovers. Makes trip-guide research automatic for anywhere the user goes instead of hand-kicked per trip. Silent when nothing is missing.

tasks.name: reservoir-mark-done
tasks.schedule_human: Daily at 7:35 AM the user's local time (30 min after daily-summary; cron-tz-sync rewrites the local fields nightly)
tasks.description: Strikes out area-guide (trip_reservoirs) places the user has already been to, so the guides stop suggesting things already done. Evidence: the daily summary first (vetted against chat + transactions + Places; catches visits that never became a stop), then GPS visits, then the travel path. Done, never removed; marks record their evidence. Runs after daily-summary because that's its primary source. Deliberately loose — the user prefers over-striking to under-striking. Cannot mark food specialties (a dish is not a place) — those rely on the site's manual done/undone button. Silent, state-only.

tasks.name: watchlist-discover
tasks.description: Monthly wide pass (60-day window, max 12) of bin/watch-discover: the model proposes new series/films from the taste profile + the user's verdicts, code enforces TMDB match, id dedup incl. rejected, IMDb >= 7.5, season 1 fully dropped. Adds to watch_titles; one phone pointer if anything was added. Cron posts job=watchlist-discover to the ops supervisor, which launches agent/scripts/watchlist-discover-run.sh via job-run (claude -p needs the Max session). Playbook: ops-agent/jobs/watchlist-discover.md.

tasks.name: watchlist-intro-email
tasks.schedule_human: Daily at 2:27 AM (dispatches only when a new title is pending)
tasks.description: One HTML email introducing every show and documentary (films go in the weekly watchlist-movies-email) added to watch_titles in the last 30 days and not yet introduced (intro_emailed_at null): TMDB backdrop + cast headshots, what it's about, the reviews (OMDb scores + searched critical reception), why the user would like it, IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes links. Several titles per email. Trigger gates in code (watchlist-intro-email --check), then posts job=watchlist-intro-email to ops-light, which launches watchlist-intro-email-run.sh via job-run (claude -p needs the Max session). Playbook: ops-agent/jobs/watchlist-intro-email.md.

tasks.name: watchlist-movies-email
tasks.schedule_human: Sundays at 4:56 AM (dispatches only when there's something to say)
tasks.description: Weekly email: films added to the list that week, best predicted first (model_p), with writeups, cast, reviews and where to watch; plus films new in theaters/streaming this week the taste model rates >= 75%. watchlist-intro-email --movies via job-run. Playbook: ops-agent/jobs/watchlist-movies-email.md.

tasks.name: watch-catalog-enrich
tasks.description: Deterministic TMDB enrichment for the watch-list recommendation model (web/watch/lib/recsys.mjs): syncs every list title (films + shows) into watch_catalog, fills genres/keywords/directors/cast, records TMDB recommendation edges in watch_film_edges, adds recommended films (>=300 votes). No LLM; cron-run direct. Playbook: ops-agent/jobs/watch-catalog-enrich.md.

tasks.name: movie-discover
tasks.description: Weekly back-catalog film harvester (bin/movie-discover): TMDB recommendations from films the viewers loved/liked on the ratings site + well-known films they marked haven't seen; code gates (not seen/listed, past 10 years, IMDb >= 6.8 (no RT/Metacritic floors), US availability, no kids/romance-led); fit by Jev site watchlist-fit (Sonnet shadow/fallback, fails closed); adds up to 5 queued. Silent — the weekly watchlist-movies-email introduces them. Cron → ops-light → job-run of movie-discover-run.sh. Playbook: ops-agent/jobs/movie-discover.md.

tasks.name: movie-db-refresh
tasks.description: Keeps the movie database (watch_catalog) fresh: TMDB now_playing → in_theaters, new US digital releases, US where-to-watch providers + release dates, and the taste model's model_p for every relevant film (past 10 years or in theaters, unseen). Feeds the ratings site Watch now, the weekly movie email and the hum in-theaters pick. Playbook: ops-agent/jobs/movie-db-refresh.md.

tasks.name: cruise-watch
tasks.description: Weekly scan for cruise deals matching the installation's travel plan and thresholds (agent/local/config/cruise-watch.json: home cities, embark ports, filters, alerts); alerts only on price drops. Off with no config or no plan.

tasks.name: chat-consolidate
phrases: remember what I said in chat
tasks.description: Nightly fold of durable facts the user states in ORDINARY CHAT (jori_messages, role=user) into the general wiki — the write-side counterpart to unified recall, so a fact he typed in conversation graduates from short-term into permanent, recallable memory. Complements daily-summary (venues visited) and hum-consolidate (hum replies). Broad + auto-apply; dedupe-before-write; skips health/financial specifics + commands/questions. The trigger (un-sandboxed cron) fetches the pending batch to a local file so the sandboxed agent turn stays fully local. Silent (no email/ping/push). Added 2026-07-19.

tasks.name: wiki-link-weave
tasks.description: Weekly wiki linking pass: splits people out of hub pages into their own `entity: person` pages (≤15/run, facts moved never dropped, links retargeted with `wiki-people retarget`), grows the nightly linker's concept map (`wiki-people concept-add`; shared or ordinary-word first names are model-only `ambiguous_aliases`), links relational phrases and ambiguous names from context in this week's changed pages + a rotating 1/8 slice, makes person relations two-way, and links or flags orphan pages. One short chat message when something changed; ≤3 hum questions. Added 2026-10-23.

tasks.name: memory-reindex
tasks.description: DISABLED 2026-05-02 (wiki migration step 5e). Was: reindex memory/*.md into memory_chunks + FTS5 + nomic-embed-text embeddings to power `memory search`. Replaced by `wiki_search` (uses pages_fts, kept current in-transaction by every savePage). Script kept around in case a manual memory_chunks rebuild is needed during recovery; cron is off.

tasks.name: wiki-link-audit
tasks.description: Nightly concept-link auto-apply (auto-apply replaced a manual-review digest). Runs `wiki-link-audit --apply --json` against the curated alias map in data/wiki-link-concepts.json — deterministic and safe (first-occurrence-only, skips code/existing-links/self-links). Since 2026-07-17, email notification is suppressed per the user's follow-up ("No need to email") — it still auto-applies and logs to agent/logs/wiki-link-audit.log, controlled by data/wiki-link-audit-config.json (`silent: true`). Direct script — no webhook, no Anthropic API.

tasks.name: memory-consolidation
tasks.description: Weekly content-level audit of the WIKI (pages table) — auto-applies merges/supersedes/retires/expands via the wiki CLI (tracked revisions, revertable), then emails a report. Diff-mode: scopes to pages changed in the last 7 days + their hybrid-recall duplication neighbors. The hygiene counterpart to the wiki's writers (daily-summary/hum-consolidate/chat-consolidate). Repointed 2026-07-19 from the legacy .md files (a no-op under DB-as-truth — render-all clobbered .md edits within 30 min) to the authoritative DB.

tasks.name: episode-archive
tasks.description: Nightly ingest of yesterday's daily_summaries row into the wiki as `day_YYYY-MM-DD` (type=day) via `wiki-day-write`. On Monday / 1st-of-month also ingests weekly + monthly rollup pages, then backfills embeddings. Direct cron script, no webhook or agent turn since 2026-10-04; 'yesterday' is the user's local yesterday (local-day). Failures to the system channel. Recallable via `bin/episode`, `wiki_search`, or the wiki HTTP browser at :9096 — episodic and permanent memory share the same `pages` table.

tasks.name: call-log
phrases: what did we talk about on the call
tasks.description: Logs every call the user hosts on Zoom (not only the recurring meetings'): code finds the ended meetings in the user's room(s) and any meeting a Zoom summary email names, a model writes an English log (summary, one-line points, next steps for the user and for the others) and matches participants to wiki person pages; stored in data/call-log.json, written to each person page's Calls block and the day page, and added to the daily summary. Recurring meetings' calls are left to their notes. Read-only on Zoom and Gmail; messages no one. No agent turn.
tasks.schedule_human: Every 30 min on the trigger-context-sync tick (no cron line of its own); prep backstop in the daily summary
